data.description:
## Context

The operator approved eleven independently filtered documentation accuracy units recorded in session log prosaic-radon-sardine. This epic coordinates those units without reopening the rejected F02, F03, or F04 proposals. F05 remains deferred. F23 and the lower README rewrite remain held.

## Plan

- Implement F14, F15, F16, F17, F18, F20, F29, F30A, F30B, F31, and F38 as bounded child tickets.
- Preserve generated-source ownership and current synchronization mechanisms.
- Apply the project writing guidelines through editorial review without adding mechanical character or prose enforcement.
- Land every repository change through Gerrit after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and resolution of all review comments.
- Close each child only after its change reaches origin/main. Close this epic only after all children are closed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The epic has exactly eleven approved implementation children and no rejected or held recommendation is included.
- [ ] Every repository child is closed after its Gerrit change reaches origin/main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
- [ ] F20 is closed after its append-only ticket correction is verified by readback.
- [ ] All eleven children are closed without force.
- [ ] The session log records the decomposition, landing evidence, and final epic outcome.
data.title: Implement approved documentation accuracy batch F14 through F38
